Question 2
(50 marks)
Setting music to a given text
Here is an extract from the poem Escape At Bedtime by Robert Louis Stevenson.
The lights from the parlour and kitchen shone out
Through the blinds and the windows and bars;
And high overhead and moving about,
There were thousands of millions of stars.
The opening line has been set for you.
• Set the remaining words to make a melody of 16 bars.
(You may exceed this number of bars and include a modulation, if you wish.)
• Add appropriate performing directions (phrasing and dynamics) to the melody.
Roughwork
